name: track–bridge interaction
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 轨道和桥梁在动态作用下的耦合联系。

complete_examples.text: A new direct probability integral method (DPIM) is introduced to achieve the stochastic analysis and reliability assessment of the train-ballasted track–bridge interaction (TTBI) system.
In this paper, the heavy-haul train-ballasted track–bridge interaction system is constructed with a combination of the finite element method and the wheel–rail coupling method.
